```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(grid)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")

study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
results_path <- file.path(main_path, "results")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures")

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))

```

```{r}
# analytic sample
dem_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP")

analytic_ids <- dem_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

sound_analytic <- sound_events %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(analytic_ids, by = "id")
```

## Markov model preparation
```{r}
markov_data <- sound_analytic %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(sound_event_order, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(event_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    response = case_when(
      responder_gender == "none" ~ 1,
      responder_gender == "Male" ~ 2,
      responder_gender == "Female" ~ 3
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, event_number, response)

markov_wide <- markov_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = event_number, values_from = response) %>%
  arrange(id)

markov_mat <- markov_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-id) %>%
  as.matrix()

dim(markov_mat)

storage.mode(markov_mat) <- "numeric"

data_list_markov <- list(
  y = markov_mat,
  K = 3,
  alpha = rep(1, 3)
)
```

## Hierarchical Markov model

```{r}
params_markov_hier <- c(
  "theta0", "theta", "theta_p",
  "theta0_prior", "theta_prior", "theta_p_prior")

samples_path_markov_hier <- file.path(results_path, "s1_jags_buttonpress_markov_hierarchical.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path_markov_hier)) {
  samples_markov_hier <- readRDS(samples_path_markov_hier)
} else {
  samples_markov_hier <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_markov,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_markov_hier,
    model.file = file.path(models_path, "s1_Markov_hierarchical.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1
  )
  saveRDS(samples_markov_hier, samples_path_markov_hier)
}

samples_markov_hier


```

```{r}
markov_draws <- as.matrix(
  as.mcmc(samples_markov_hier)
)

p_none_persist <- markov_draws[, "theta[1,1]"]
p_male_persist <- markov_draws[, "theta[2,2]"]
p_female_persist <- markov_draws[, "theta[3,3]"]

persistence_differences <- tibble(
  comparison = c(
    "Female − male",
    "No press − male",
    "No press − female"),
  difference = list(
    p_female_persist - p_male_persist,
    p_none_persist - p_male_persist,
    p_none_persist - p_female_persist)) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_difference = map_dbl(
      difference,
      mean),
    lower_95_CrI = map_dbl(
      difference,
      ~ quantile(.x, probs = .025)),
    upper_95_CrI = map_dbl(
      difference,
      ~ quantile(.x, probs = .975)),
    posterior_probability_positive = map_dbl(
      difference,
      ~ mean(.x > 0)),
    posterior_probability_negative = map_dbl(
      difference,
      ~ mean(.x < 0))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-difference)

persistence_differences %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```


```{r}
plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_buttonpress_markov_traceplots.png")

if (file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
} else {
  mcmc_list_markov <- as.mcmc(samples_markov_hier)

  trace_df_markov <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    mcmc_list_markov,
    seq_along(mcmc_list_markov),
    ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
      rownames_to_column("iteration") %>%
      mutate(
        iteration = as.integer(iteration),
        chain = paste0("chain_", .y)
      )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      iteration, chain,
      `theta0[1]`, `theta0[2]`, `theta0[3]`,
      `theta[1,1]`, `theta[2,2]`, `theta[3,3]`
    ) %>%
    group_by(chain) %>%
    slice(seq(1, n(), by = 20)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(iteration, chain),
      names_to = "parameter",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      parameter = factor(
        parameter,
        levels = c(
          "theta0[1]", "theta0[2]", "theta0[3]",
          "theta[1,1]", "theta[2,2]", "theta[3,3]"
        ),
        labels = c(
          "theta0[none]", "theta0[male]", "theta0[female]",
          "theta[none,none]", "theta[male,male]", "theta[female,female]"
        )
      )
    )

  p_trace_markov <- ggplot(trace_df_markov, aes(x = iteration, y = value, colour = chain)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.25) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "Iteration",
      y = "Value",
      colour = "Chain"
    )

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_trace_markov,
    width = 8,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r}
hier_summary <- samples_markov_hier$BUGSoutput$summary %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("parameter")

theta0_hier <- hier_summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(parameter, "^theta0\\[")) %>%
  mutate(state = str_match(parameter, "^theta0\\[(\\d+)\\]")[, 2] %>% as.integer()) %>%
  transmute(
    state = factor(state, levels = 1:3, labels = c("none", "male", "female")),
    mean = mean,
    lower = `2.5%`,
    upper = `97.5%`
  )

theta_hier <- hier_summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(parameter, "^theta\\[")) %>%
  mutate(
    from = str_match(parameter, "^theta\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")[, 2] %>% as.integer(),
    to   = str_match(parameter, "^theta\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")[, 3] %>% as.integer()
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    from = factor(from, levels = 1:3, labels = c("none", "male", "female")),
    to   = factor(to, levels = 1:3, labels = c("none", "male", "female")),
    mean = mean,
    lower = `2.5%`,
    upper = `97.5%`
  )

```

```{r}
plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_buttonpress_markov_transition_densities.png")

if (file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
} else {
  s_hier_markov <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_markov_hier))

  theta_hier_post_long <- as_tibble(s_hier_markov) %>%
    dplyr::select(matches("^theta\\[")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      from = str_match(parameter, "^theta\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")[, 2] %>% as.integer(),
      to   = str_match(parameter, "^theta\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")[, 3] %>% as.integer(),
      from = factor(from, levels = 1:3, labels = c("none", "male", "female")),
      to   = factor(to, levels = 1:3, labels = c("none", "male", "female")),
      source = "posterior"
    )

  theta_hier_prior_long <- as_tibble(s_hier_markov) %>%
    dplyr::select(matches("^theta_prior\\[")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      from = str_match(parameter, "^theta_prior\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")[, 2] %>% as.integer(),
      to   = str_match(parameter, "^theta_prior\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")[, 3] %>% as.integer(),
      from = factor(from, levels = 1:3, labels = c("none", "male", "female")),
      to   = factor(to, levels = 1:3, labels = c("none", "male", "female")),
      source = "prior"
    )


  p_markov_transition_density <- ggplot() +
    geom_density(
      data = theta_hier_post_long,
      aes(x = value, fill = to),
      alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_density(
      data = theta_hier_prior_long,
      aes(x = value, colour = to),
      fill = NA,
      linetype = 2,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    facet_grid(from ~ 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "Transition probability",
      y = "Density"
    )

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_markov_transition_density,
    width = 8,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_buttonpress_markov_selected_dyads.png")

if (file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
} else {
  selected_dyads <- c(1, 10, 25, 40)

  selected_dyad_labels <- markov_wide %>%
    mutate(dyad = row_number()) %>%
    filter(dyad %in% selected_dyads) %>%
    dplyr::select(dyad, id) %>%
    mutate(dyad_label = paste0(id))

  theta_p_post_selected <- extract_theta_p_draws(
    samples_markov_hier,
    "main",
    dyads_keep = selected_dyads,
    from_keep = 1:3,
    to_keep = 1:3
  ) %>%
    filter(
      (from == "none" & to == "none") |
        (from == "male" & to == "male") |
        (from == "female" & to == "female")
    ) %>%
    left_join(selected_dyad_labels, by = "dyad") %>%
    mutate(
      transition = factor(
        paste0(from, " -> ", to),
        levels = c("none -> none", "male -> male", "female -> female")
      ),
      source = "posterior"
    )

  theta_p_prior_selected <- extract_theta_p_prior_draws(
    samples_markov_hier,
    "main",
    dyads_keep = selected_dyads,
    from_keep = 1:3,
    to_keep = 1:3
  ) %>%
    filter(
      (from == "none" & to == "none") |
        (from == "male" & to == "male") |
        (from == "female" & to == "female")
    ) %>%
    left_join(selected_dyad_labels, by = "dyad") %>%
    mutate(
      transition = factor(
        paste0(from, " -> ", to),
        levels = c("none -> none", "male -> male", "female -> female")
      ),
      source = "prior"
    )

  p_markov_selected_dyads <- bind_rows(theta_p_post_selected, theta_p_prior_selected) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
    geom_density(
      data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, source == "posterior"),
      aes(fill = dyad_label, colour = dyad_label),
      alpha = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_density(
      data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, source == "prior"),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(x = value),
      colour = "black",
      linetype = 2,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ transition, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Hierarchical Markov: prior vs posterior for selected dyads",
      subtitle = "Persistence transitions shown for selected dyads; coloured fills = posterior, black dashed line = monitored prior draws",
      x = "Transition probability",
      y = "Density",
      colour = "Dyad",
      fill = "Dyad"
    )

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_markov_selected_dyads,
    width = 10,
    height = 4,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

## Dyad-level heterogeneity in the hierarchical Markov model

```{r}
plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_buttonpress_markov_dyad_persistence.png")

if (file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
} else {
  theta_p_post_means <- extract_theta_p_draws(
    samples_markov_hier,
    "posterior",
    from_keep = 1:3,
    to_keep = 1:3
  ) %>%
    filter(
      (from == "none" & to == "none") |
        (from == "male" & to == "male") |
        (from == "female" & to == "female")
    ) %>%
    group_by(dyad, from, to) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      transition = factor(
        paste0(from, " -> ", to),
        levels = c("none -> none", "male -> male", "female -> female")
      )
    )

  p_markov_dyad_persistence <- ggplot(theta_p_post_means, aes(value, fill = transition, colour = transition)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.5) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of dyad-level persistence probabilities",
      subtitle = "Posterior means across dyads from the hierarchical Markov model",
      x = "Posterior mean transition probability",
      y = "Density",
      fill = "Transition",
      colour = "Transition"
    )

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_markov_dyad_persistence,
    width = 8,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```


```{r}
transition_graph_df <- theta_hier %>%
  mutate(
    from = as.character(from),
    to = as.character(to),
    trans = round(mean, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(from, to, trans)

vertex_df <- tibble(
  name = c(
    "none",
    "male",
    "female"
  ),
  x = c(0, -1, 1),
  y = c(1, 0, 0),
  p0 = round(
    theta0_hier$mean[
      match(
        c("none", "male", "female"),
        as.character(theta0_hier$state)
      )
    ],
    2
  )
)

graph <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = transition_graph_df,
  vertices = vertex_df,
  directed = TRUE
)

p_markov_network <- ggraph(graph, layout = "manual", x = vertex_df$x, y = vertex_df$y) +
  geom_edge_fan(
    aes(alpha = trans, label = trans),
    angle_calc = "along",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, "mm")),
    start_cap = circle(6, "mm"),
    end_cap = circle(6.5, "mm"),
    label_dodge = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    label_size = 2.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_edge_loop(
    aes(alpha = trans, label = trans),
    angle_calc = "along",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, "mm")),
    start_cap = circle(6, "mm"),
    end_cap = circle(6.5, "mm"),
    label_dodge = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    label_size = 2.5, 
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_node_point(aes(x = x, y = y, color = name), size = 10) +
  geom_node_text(aes(x = x, y = y, label = p0), color = "white", size = 3) +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      none = "#9487b6",
      male = "#eb8005",
      female = "#2A9D8F"
    ),
    labels = c(
      none = "None",
      male = "Male",
      female = "Female"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    color = "Button-press response"
  ) +
  theme(
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8.5, lineheight = 0.9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 25, r = 35, b = 25, l = 35))

plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_buttonpress_markov_network.png")

if (file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
} else {
  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_markov_network,
    width = 8,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```
